correctness.rationale: Counting shared columns gives c; the remaining s=n-c exclusive columns split as a+b=s. Classical NODF zeroes equal-degree pairs, producing N=(cs+1_{2x>s} c/(n-x))/(1+binom(n,2)). If both row vertices are in same Barber community, all column contributions cancel; if separate, each degree-one column contributes k_other, and each shared column contributes |k1-k2| to E²Q at optimum. Each choice is simultaneously achievable, even when arbitrary other communities allowed; Q*=2x(n-x)/(n+c)². N is strictly increasing in x; the concave quadratic first rises then falls, yielding Pareto x>=min(s,ceil(n/2)). Ferrers x=s compared with x=s-1 yields threshold n-2s+1=2c-n+1>=0; s=1 boundary is singleton. Independently enumerated all unrestricted vertex set partitions for every admissible labeled matrix n=2..5, with exact fraction arithmetic, and rederived every NODF and Barber optimum. This is bounded corroboration; all-n proof uses direct column/partition reduction.
